objects.name: base
objects.prompt: A neat stockpile stack of cut wooden logs for a fantasy goblin settlement, arranged in a compact piled bundle. Short to medium-sized logs with visible cut ends, rough bark, and natural variations in shape and thickness. Warm earthy browns with slightly darker bark and lighter sawn ends, a few small twigs or bark details, and an organised but slightly rustic look. Designed as a stored resource for a cute underground colony sim. Whimsical dark fairy-tale aesthetic, cute fantasy pixel art, fixed three-quarter JRPG perspective, 32×32 sprite style, crisp pixel placement, thick clean black outlines, limited harmonious colour palette, subtle shading, clear readable silhouette, transparent background, isolated object, no scenery, no text.
